rationale: The target form mṣalṭile has the preterite agent ending -le with a plural object (the eyes). It follows zbəṭle and ḥəṣle in the same completed-action sequence; the corpus translates richtete sie ... gegen die Sonne. It is not an Infectum form of the listed base mṣaləṭ. Move the example to a Preterit box in stem II.
